summary: Implemented parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError in rdflib/extras/shacl.py and added test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (42 passed) under the prepared venv. Nothing is committed and no existing file changed. Not verified: mypy and black are not installed in the venv, so the type-ignore placement and formatting were checked by reading only. Judgment calls: a guard rejects any non-Node input before graph lookups, because Graph treats None as a wildcard; nested sequences and alternatives flatten via the path constructors, so tests compare against flattened expectations; type-ignore comments sit on the parser-call lines where the checker reports arg-type.
